name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based royalty and streaming company focused on precious metals assets in Nevada and Idaho. The company combines mineral royalty creation and acquisition, precious-metals streaming, and an exploration project accelerator, and trades on the OTCQX Best Market. Its primary asset is a 3% net smelter royalty and exploration earn-in on the Lapon Canyon Gold Project in the Walker Lane gold trend of Nevada, where a 10,000-metre RC drill program was underway as of 2026.
